about.title: Kumanga Mayankho a Digital Zomwe Zimapititsa Mabizinesi Patsogolo
about.description:
Oklut Technologies ndi kampani yopanga mayankho aukadaulo omwe amayang'ana kwambiri kuthandiza mabizinesi kusintha malingaliro kukhala zokumana nazo za digito. Timaphatikiza ukadaulo, ukadaulo, ndi kumvetsetsa kwamabizinesi kuti tipereke mayankho omwe amapangidwa molingana ndi zosowa zenizeni padziko lapansi.

Kuchokera pakusintha kwa digito ndi kukonza mapulogalamu amwambo kupita ku cloud, AI, automation, ndi ntchito zaukadaulo zoyendetsedwa, timathandizira mabungwe kupangitsa kuti zinthu zizivuta, kukonza bwino, ndikupanga phindu la digito lokhalitsa.

Njira yathu ndi yosavuta — kumvetsetsa zovuta, ndi kukonza ukadaulo.

section1.title: 1. Chidziwitso chomwe Timachisonkhanitsa
body: Timasonkhanitsa zidziwitso zomwe mumapereka mwachindunji (monga dzina lanu ndi imelo adilesi mukatumiza fomu yolumikizirana kapena kupanga akaunti) komanso zomwe zimasonkhanitsidwa zokha kudzera m'macookie ndi matekinoloje ofananira nawo, monga masamba omwe adachezera, mtundu wa chipangizocho komanso pafupifupi malo.

section2.title: 2. Momwe Timagwiritsira Ntchito Ma cookie
body: Ma cookie ofunikira amakhala oyatsidwa nthawi zonse chifukwa tsamba silingagwire bwino ntchito popanda iwo. Amasunga gawo ndi chitsimikiziro ndikukumbukira zomwe mumakonda ma cookie.

Ma cookies a Analytics amatithandiza kumvetsetsa momwe alendo amagwiritsira ntchito tsambali kuti tiwongolere. Ma cookie otsatsa amagwiritsidwa ntchito kukuwonetsani zomwe mukufuna komanso makampeni. Magawowa amangoyatsidwa ndi chilolezo chanu ndipo mutha kusinthidwa nthawi iliyonse kuchokera pagulu lokonda ma cookie.

section3.title: 3. Maziko azamalamulo (GDPR)
body: Timakonza zidziwitso zaumwini pazifukwa zotsatirazi zazamalamulo: kuvomereza kwanu (kwa makeke osafunikira ndi kutsatsa), magwiridwe antchito (pantchito zomwe mwapempha), zomwe mumafunikira pazamalamulo, ndi zokonda zovomerezeka pomwe maufulu anu sapitilira. Mutha kuchotsa chilolezo nthawi iliyonse popanda kukhudza kuvomerezeka kwazomwe zimachitika musanachoke.

section4.title: 4. Ufulu Wanu
body: Kutengera ndi komwe muli, mutha kukhala ndi ufulu wopeza, kukonza, kufufuta, kapena kuletsa kukonzedwa kwa data yanu, kukana kukonzedwa, komanso kusuntha kwa data. Mukhozanso kudandaula ndi oyang'anira dera lanu.

section5.title: 5. Kusunga Deta & Chitetezo
body: Timasunga zambiri zaumwini pokhapokha ngati kuli kofunikira pazifukwa zomwe zafotokozedwa mu ndondomekoyi. Timagwiritsa ntchito njira zoyenera zaukadaulo ndi bungwe kuti titeteze zambiri zanu kuti zisapezeke, kusinthidwa, kuwululidwa kapena kuwonongedwa.

section6.title: 6. Ntchito Zachipani Chachitatu
body: Ma cookie ena atha kukhazikitsidwa ndi othandizira ena (monga ma analytics kapena nsanja zotsatsa) zomwe zimatithandiza kugwiritsa ntchito tsambalo. Othandizirawa amakonza deta pansi pa ndondomeko zawo zachinsinsi komanso pokhapokha ngati mwavomereza gulu loyenera.

overview: Artificial Intelligence ndi Robotic akusintha momwe mabungwe amagwirira ntchito, kupanga zisankho, ndikupereka phindu. Mayankho athu a AI & Robotic amathandizira mabizinesi kupitilira zongochitika zokha mwa kuphatikiza luntha lochita kupanga, kuphunzira pamakina, masomphenya apakompyuta, makina anzeru, ndi ma robotiki kuti athetse zovuta zamabizinesi.

Timapanga mayankho anzeru potengera zotsatira zabizinesi. Kaya chofunikira ndikungopanga ntchito yobwerezabwereza, kusanthula zidziwitso zambiri, kuzindikira mawonekedwe, zisankho zothandizira, kapena kuyambitsa ma robotiki m'malo ogwirira ntchito, njira yathu imayang'ana kwambiri kudalirika, scalability, chitetezo, komanso kufunikira kwabizinesi kwanthawi yayitali.
transformation: Mabungwe amakono amapanga deta yochuluka kwambiri ndipo amachita zinthu zambirimbiri zobwerezabwereza tsiku lililonse. AI ndi ma robotiki amatha kusintha izi kukhala zanzeru, zoyenda zokha zomwe zimakulitsa zokolola pomwe zimalola antchito kuyang'ana kwambiri maudindo apamwamba.

Mayankho athu angathandize mabungwe kuti azigwira ntchito mobwerezabwereza, kuchepetsa kulowererapo pamanja, kukonza zolondola, kusanthula zidziwitso zovuta, kuthandizira zisankho mwachangu, kukhathamiritsa kagwiritsidwe ntchito kazinthu, kukulitsa zomwe makasitomala akumana nazo, ndikupanga machitidwe anzeru owopsa.

customDevelopment.description: Kutha-kumapeto kwa njira zatsopano za digito kuchokera ku zofunikira zabizinesi ndi mamangidwe a mayankho kudzera mu chitukuko, kuphatikiza, kuyesa, kutumiza, ndi kuthandizira kosalekeza.
customDevelopment.row1Title: Kupititsa patsogolo Kumapeto-Kumapeto kuchokera ku Zofunikira mpaka Pamlingo
customDevelopment.row1P1: Njira iliyonse yatsopano ya digito imayamba ndi zofunikira zapadera, mayendedwe ogwirira ntchito, ndi zolinga zanzeru zomwe sizingakwaniritsidwe ndi pulogalamu yamtundu umodzi. Timakhazikika pakumanga machitidwe, mapulogalamu apamwamba kwambiri kuyambira pachiyambi.
customDevelopment.row1P2: Kuyambira pa zofunika zoyamba zotulukira ndi kamangidwe ka luso la zomangamanga mpaka pa chitukuko cha liwiro lothamanga, kuphatikizika kwa API ecosystem, mapaipi oyesera amphamvu, ndi kutumiza mitambo paotomatiki, magulu athu akuluakulu a uinjiniya amatenga umwini wonse wa moyo wazinthu zanu.
customDevelopment.row2Title: Scalable Systems Zopangidwira Kukula kwa Bizinesi
customDevelopment.row2P1: Timapanga mapulogalamu olimba olimba kuti athe kupirira katundu wolemetsa. Kuchokera ku ma modular microservices ndi ma backends oyendetsedwa ndi zochitika kupita kumayendedwe apamwamba a data ndi GraphQL/REST APIs, timapanga nsanja zomwe zimakulirakulirabe.
customDevelopment.row2P2: Pokhazikitsa ma codebase oyera, ophatikizidwa ndi kuyezetsa kodziwikiratu komanso kutsatira mosalekeza chitetezo, timaonetsetsa kuti pulogalamu yanu ya pulogalamuyo ndiyokhazikika, yowerengeka, komanso yokonzeka kusinthika kwakanthawi.
customDevelopment.row3Title: Kutumiza kwa Agile ndi Mapaipi Odzichitira

customDevelopment.row3P2: Ndi ma demos owonekera bwino, kuwonetsetsa kwa nthawi yeniyeni, ndi liwiro loyendetsedwa ndi zochitika zazikulu, timatsimikizira nthawi yopita kumsika popanda kusokoneza chitetezo, kukhazikika, kapena chidziwitso cha ogwiritsa ntchito.
customDevelopment.row4Title: Ntchito Zodalirika za 24/7 ndi Kusintha Kwanthawi Yaitali
customDevelopment.row4P1: Kukhala moyo ndi chiyambi chabe. Timapereka kuwunika kokhazikika, kukonza mothandizidwa ndi SLA, kukhathamiritsa kwazinthu zamtambo, kukonza magwiridwe antchito, ndi kutulutsa kosalekeza.
customDevelopment.row4P2: Gulu lathu la mainjiniya limagwira ntchito ngati chiwonjezeko chachilengedwe cha bungwe lanu, kuwonetsetsa kuti palibe nthawi yopumira komanso kupitilira patsogolo kwaukadaulo pamsika wanu.
customDevelopment.pillarsSub: Maluso athunthu opangidwa kuti atenge malingaliro anu kuchokera paziro mpaka kupanga.
customDevelopment.pillar1Desc: Kusanthula kwamabizinesi mozama, mawonekedwe ogwirira ntchito, ndi mapu aulendo wa ogwiritsa ntchito kuti afotokozere malire ake.

customDevelopment.pillar3Desc: Mapulogalamu amakono a intaneti ndi mafoni am'manja opangidwa ndi ma code aukhondo, chitetezo chamtundu, komanso miyezo yokhazikika ya UI.
customDevelopment.pillar4Desc: High-throughput REST/GraphQL APIs, orchestrations webhook, zipata zolipira, ndi kulunzanitsa kwachitatu kwa ERP/CRM.

processAutomation.row2P2: Fikirani mitengo yowongoka yopitilira 95% pomwe mumachepetsa kwambiri nthawi yosinthira kuyambira masiku kupita masekondi.
processAutomation.row3P1: Lumikizani CRM, ERP, HRMS, ndi ma API aku banki kuti muyendetse deta yogwirizana munthawi yeniyeni. Timagwiritsa ntchito zoyambitsa zochitika zoyendetsedwa ndi zochitika, mizere ya mauthenga, ndi zowongolera zobwerera zokha.
processAutomation.row3P2: Chidziwitso chimayenda bwino m'madipatimenti onse popanda kulowererapo kwa anthu, kuthetsa ma silo ogwirira ntchito komanso kuchedwa kwa kulumikizana.

processAutomation.pillar2Desc: Bots yokhazikitsidwa ndi malamulo yomwe ikuchita chizolowezi cholowa, kuyanjanitsa, ndi ntchito zosiyanasiyana.
processAutomation.pillar3Desc: Othandizira ozindikira a AI omwe amamasulira nkhani, kufotokoza mwachidule mawu osalongosoka, ndikupanga zisankho zokha.
processAutomation.pillar4Desc: Njira za migodi, kuzindikira kwa botolo, ndi kayendedwe ka ntchito ka Kaizen komwe kumachepetsa ndalama zogwirira ntchito mosalekeza.
processAutomation.ctaSub: Lumikizanani ndi okonza makina athu kuti muzindikire mwayi wa ROI wapamwamba ndikuyika mayendedwe anzeru a digito.

digitalTransformation.pillar3Desc: Njira zodzichitira mwanzeru, ma AI othandizira, ndi telemetry yolosera kuti mukwaniritse ntchito za tsiku ndi tsiku.

endToEndSolutions.row1P2: Timatanthawuza zitsanzo za data, zotetezera, ndi zochitika zazikulu zomwe zimakhazikitsa kupambana kwa nthawi yaitali.
endToEndSolutions.row2P1: Modular microservices, ma API otetezeka amtundu, ndi ma frontend omvera ophatikizidwa ndi ma unit automated, kuphatikiza, ndi masikani achitetezo.
endToEndSolutions.row2P2: Mapaipi ophatikizika mosalekeza ndi GitHub Actions, Terraform, ndi makina oteteza chitetezo.
endToEndSolutions.row3P1: Kuimba kwa mitambo yambiri pa AWS/Azure/GCP yokhala ndi makina obweza kumbuyo, zodulira zero-downtime, komanso kuwonera nthawi yeniyeni.
endToEndSolutions.row3P2: Timapereka chisamaliro chochirikizidwa ndi SLA ndikuwunika mosalekeza pa telemetry kuti tisinthe malonda anu mosasinthika.
endToEndSolutions.row4P1: Kuyankha pamfundo imodzi pamtundu wanu wonse wa digito - kuthamanga kwa liwiro lowonekera, bajeti yodziwikiratu, komanso ukadaulo wopitilira.
endToEndSolutions.row4P2: Kutulutsa pafupipafupi komanso kusintha kwamakono kumapangitsa kuti bizinesi yanu ikhale patsogolo pa mpikisano.
endToEndSolutions.pillar1Desc: Kupezeka kwa malo, misewu yomanga, ndi kulumikizana kwa omwe akukhudzidwa kuti athetse ziwopsezo zakupha.

migrationServices.description: Kusamuka kotetezedwa, kolongosoka kwa ntchito zakale, nkhokwe zosungiramo zinthu zakale, ndi zomangamanga kupita kumapangidwe amakono amtambo, ophatikizidwa ndi kusinthika kosalekeza kuti azitha kuchita bwino komanso kuchita bwino.
migrationServices.row1P1: Kusamuka kosasunthika kwa ntchito kudutsa AWS, Azure, ndi Google Cloud ndi zodziwikiratu, kukonza mafunde, komanso kusokoneza bizinesi.
migrationServices.row1P2: Timalinganiza rehosting, replatforming, ndi refactoring kuti tikwaniritse mtengo wonse wa umwini (TCO) ndi mphamvu.
migrationServices.row2P1: Kubwereza kobwerezabwereza kwa database, kumasulira kwa schema, ndi mapaipi apamwamba a ETL ndi 100% yotsimikizira kukhulupirika kwa data.
migrationServices.row2P2: Zero-downtime cutover rehearsal zimatsimikizira kusasinthika kwa data ndi kupitiliza kwa bizinesi.
migrationServices.row3P1: Sinthani ma monoliths amakono kukhala ma microservices owopsa opangidwa kudzera Kubernetes (EKS, AKS, GKE) okhala ndi mapulani a IaC.
migrationServices.row3P2: Mbiri ya ntchito yosamukira pambuyo pa kusamuka ndi kukhathamiritsa kwa mtengo zimatsimikizira ROI yanthawi yayitali.
migrationServices.row4Title: Mayeso Odzichitira okha & Rollback Safety Nets
migrationServices.row4P1: Ma cutover runbook oyeserera nkhondo, ma automated regression suites, ndi njira zobweza pompopompo kuti mukhale ndi mtendere wamumtima.
migrationServices.row4P2: Telemetry yaumoyo wapambuyo-kusamuka ndi 24/7 hypercare zimatsimikizira kukhazikika kopanga kopanda cholakwika.
migrationServices.pillarsSub: Mayendedwe ochotsedwa pachiwopsezo mothandizidwa ndi ma SLA amabizinesi.
migrationServices.pillar1Desc: Kutulutsa kwa Canary ndi kulunzanitsa kwapawiri-kulemba kuti muwonetsetse kuti ogwiritsa ntchito sangasokonezeke.
migrationServices.pillar2Desc: Kufananitsa kwa Checksum, kuwunika kwa schema integrity, ndi kuyanjanitsa kwa ETL.
migrationServices.pillar3Desc: Ndondomeko zolimba zobwezeretsa masoka ndi zoyeserera kuti zikhale ndi chiopsezo pagawo lililonse.
migrationServices.pillar4Desc: Kuyika ufulu wamtambo, ndondomeko za autoscaling, ndi ma dashboards oyendetsera ndalama akuphatikizidwa.
migrationServices.ctaSub: Gwirizanani ndi Oklut Technologies pamtambo wokhazikika, wopanda chiwopsezo komanso kusintha kwa data.

pilotPrototyping.description: Kupititsa patsogolo mofulumira ndi kutsimikiziridwa kwa mayankho aukadaulo kuti awone kuthekera kwaukadaulo, mtengo wabizinesi, zofunika kuphatikiza, magwiridwe antchito, ndi scalability musanayambe kukhazikitsidwa kwathunthu.
pilotPrototyping.row1Title: Kuchokera ku Lingaliro kupita ku Zotheka Zovomerezeka
pilotPrototyping.row1P1: Kusintha lingaliro kukhala yankho labizinesi kumafuna kutsimikizika koyambirira. Ntchito yathu ya PoC & Pilot imawunika luso laukadaulo, kuyesa kupsinjika kophatikizana kofunikira, ndikutsimikizira ROI yabizinesi isanapereke ndalama zazikulu.
pilotPrototyping.row1P2: Timapanga ma MVP odalirika kwambiri komanso oyendetsa sandbox olunjika omwe amatsimikizira kuthekera kwaukadaulo, kuyeza kuchedwa kwadongosolo, ndikusonkhanitsa zotsimikizira mwachindunji za omwe akukhudzidwa nawo posachedwa.
pilotPrototyping.row1Cap: Kujambula Kwachangu kwa MVP & Benchmarks Zaukadaulo
pilotPrototyping.row2Title: Ma MVP Ogwiritsa & Kutsimikizika kwa UX
pilotPrototyping.row2P1: Timamanga ma wireframe olumikizirana, mayendedwe osavuta ogwiritsira ntchito, komanso malingaliro otsimikizira m'masiku, osati miyezi. Yesani kuyanjana kwenikweni kwa ogwiritsa ntchito, yengani mawonekedwe a UI/UX, ndikupeza mayankho okhudzidwa kuchokera kwa omwe akukhudzidwa nawo.
pilotPrototyping.row2P2: Pofupikitsa malingaliro awo panthawi yopititsa patsogolo, gulu lanu limachepetsa kukonzanso ndikukhazikitsa zomveka bwino magawo omanga otengera ndalama zambiri asanayambe.
pilotPrototyping.row3P1: Zindikirani zolepheretsa zaukadaulo, malire a API, ndi zovuta zogwirira ntchito musanapereke ndalama zonse. Gulu lathu loyendetsa ndege limayesa kuphatikiza, mapaipi a data, ndi ma API a gulu lachitatu m'malo a sandbox akutali.
pilotPrototyping.row3P2: Kuchepetsa kwachiwopsezo kumeneku kumawonetsetsa kupezeka kwadongosolo, kutsata chitetezo, komanso nthawi yodziwikiratu yachitukuko mukasintha PoC yanu kukhala bizinesi.
pilotPrototyping.row4Title: Kukhazikitsa Oyendetsa Omwe Akuwatsogolera & Kutsimikizira Nkhani Yabizinesi
pilotPrototyping.row4P1: Tumizani zotulutsidwa za oyendetsa omwe akutsata kugawo losankhidwa la ogwiritsa ntchito kapena msika woyesera. Tsatirani ma metrics ogwirira ntchito, kusanthula kwa ogwiritsa ntchito, ndi mayankho ogwirira ntchito kuti muyese kuchuluka kwabizinesi ndikukhazikitsa bizinesi yochirikizidwa ndi data.
pilotPrototyping.row4P2: Ndi zidziwitso zenizeni za oyendetsa dziko lapansi, othandizira akuluakulu amapeza ma metrics omveka bwino a ROI kuti atsimikizire kutumizidwa kokulirapo komanso ndalama zosinthira digito.
pilotPrototyping.pillarsSub: Mfundo zotsogola zomwe zimasintha kusatsimikizika kwaukadaulo kukhala kuchita bwino kwabizinesi.
pilotPrototyping.pillar1Desc: Perekani ma prototypes ogwira ntchito mwachangu kuti atsimikizire malingaliro amtengo wapatali kumayambiriro kwa moyo.
pilotPrototyping.pillar2Desc: Tsimikizirani kuyenderana kwa API, malire opitilira muyeso, ndi zolepheretsa kutsatira m'malo a sandbox.
pilotPrototyping.pillar3Desc: Tsanzirani kuchuluka kwa kupanga kuti mukhazikitse malire a mphamvu ndikuzindikira kukula kwa kamangidwe ka mitambo.
pilotPrototyping.pillar4Desc: Kuwerengera ROI zogwirika ndi zokolola kuti zithandizire zisankho zamakampani onse.
pilotPrototyping.ctaTitle: Mwakonzeka kutsimikizira yankho lanu lotsatira la digito?
pilotPrototyping.ctaSub: Lumikizanani ndi gulu lathu la mainjiniya kuti mufufuze zomwe mukufuna pulojekiti yanu, pangani chitsanzo, ndikuyesa kutheka popanda chiopsezo chilichonse.

sharedServices.row1P1: Gwirizanitsani IT ya back-office, kasamalidwe ka zomangamanga, ndi chithandizo chaukadaulo kukhala malo amodzi operekera bwino kwambiri.
sharedServices.row1P2: Pochotsa zobwerezabwereza zamagulu ndi kulinganiza njira zoyendetsera ntchito, bungwe lanu limakhala lokhazikika komanso limatsitsa ndalama zonse zogwirira ntchito.
sharedServices.row2Title: Kuyang'anira Mwachidwi & Kuthana ndi Zochitika Mwachangu
sharedServices.row2P1: Akatswiri athu odzipereka a Site Reliability Engineers (SRE) ndi akatswiri othandizira amapereka 24/7/365 telemetry monitoring, automated alert triage, ndi kuthetsa mwamsanga L1/L2/L3.
sharedServices.row2P2: Mothandizidwa ndi malonjezano okhwima a SLA, tikukutsimikizirani kupezeka kwa 99.99% pamapulogalamu anu ofunikira kwambiri komanso zomangamanga zamtambo.

sharedServices.row3P2: Njira zowerengera bwino komanso malamulo oyendetsera ntchito zimatsimikizira kuti ntchito zanu zikugwirizana ndi miyezo yapadziko lonse lapansi yachitetezo.

sharedServices.pillar1Desc: Proactive NOC telemetry, patching server, kukonza zomangamanga, ndi 99.99% uptime chitsimikizo.
sharedServices.pillar2Desc: Tier 1/2/3 desiki yothandizira ma tchanelo ambiri, mayendedwe a zochitika, ndi mayendedwe okonzekera matikiti.
sharedServices.pillar3Desc: Nthawi zoyankhira mothandizidwa ndi makontrakitala, ma benchmark a MTTR, ndi zowunikira zowunikira mwezi uliwonse.
sharedServices.pillar4Desc: Kukula kosalekeza kwa gwero, kubwezanso ziphaso, ndi kuchepetsa mtengo wamtambo.
sharedServices.ctaSub: Gwirizanani ndi Oklut Technologies pazantchito zodalirika, zoyendetsedwa ndi 24/7 zomwe zimakulitsa mtengo ndikuchotsa kutha kwa ntchito.

aiRobotics.intro: Artificial Intelligence (AI) ndi Robotic akusintha momwe mabizinesi amagwirira ntchito pophatikiza kupanga zisankho mwanzeru ndi makina apamwamba kwambiri. AI imathandizira makina kusanthula deta, kuphunzira machitidwe, ndi kupanga zisankho zanzeru, pomwe ma robotiki amabweretsa izi kudziko lapansi kuti agwire ntchito mwachangu, molondola, komanso mosasinthasintha.
aiRobotics.section1Text: Mayankho athu a AI ndi Robotic amathandizira mabungwe kukonza magwiridwe antchito, kuchepetsa zoyeserera, komanso kukonza zokolola m'mafakitale osiyanasiyana. Kuchokera pakupanga makina ndi ma analytics olosera mpaka ma robotiki anzeru ndi machitidwe anzeru, timapereka matekinoloje apamwamba omwe amapititsa patsogolo luso, kulimbikitsa kukula, ndikuthandizira kusintha kwa digito.
aiRobotics.section2Text: Kuyanjana kulikonse, chisankho, ndi kuyenda kumayendetsedwa ndi dongosolo limodzi lolumikizidwa - kutembenuza deta kukhala zotsatira mu nthawi yeniyeni.

informationReporting.heroSubtitle: Gwero limodzi lachowonadi ku dipatimenti iliyonse - yopangidwa kuti isandutse deta yosasinthika kukhala zisankho zomwe bizinesi yanu ingachite lero.
informationReporting.section1Heading: Dongosolo limodzi lapakati pa metric iliyonse yomwe ili yofunika
informationReporting.section1P1: Information & Reporting Systems ndi mayankho ofunikira amabizinesi omwe amathandizira mabungwe kusonkhanitsa, kuyang'anira, ndikusintha zidziwitso kukhala zidziwitso zomveka. Machitidwewa amaphatikiza mauthenga ochokera m'madipatimenti angapo, kuonetsetsa kuti ali ndi chidziwitso cholondola, chokhazikika, komanso nthawi yeniyeni ku deta yovuta yamalonda. Popereka nsanja yapakati yoyendetsera zidziwitso, mabungwe amatha kukonza mawonekedwe ogwirira ntchito, kuwongolera kayendetsedwe ka ntchito, ndikuthandizira kupanga zisankho zanzeru pamagawo onse abizinesi.
informationReporting.section1P2: Makinawa amagwiritsa ntchito malipoti odzichitira okha, ma analytics, ndi ma dashboards kuti azitha kuyang'anira magwiridwe antchito, kuyang'anira ma metrics ofunikira, ndikupanga malipoti anthawi yeniyeni. Pochepetsa kuyeserera pamanja ndikuwongolera kulondola kwa data, mabizinesi amatha kupanga zisankho mwachangu komanso zogwira mtima.
informationReporting.section2Heading: Zapangidwa kuti ziwoneke, kutsata, ndi kukula
informationReporting.section2Text: Ndi mawonekedwe owoneka bwino, kutsata, ndi mgwirizano, Information & Reporting Systems imathandizira mabungwe kukhathamiritsa njira, kupititsa patsogolo zokolola, ndikuyendetsa bizinesi yokhazikika m'malo ampikisano.

businessTransformation.sec3Subtext: Mabizinesi amapita ku kamangidwe koyendetsedwa ndi zochitika, koyambirira kwa API komwe deta imayenda modalirika pamapulatifomu oyambira ndikufikira opanga zisankho munthawi yeniyeni.
businessTransformation.sec4Subtext: Ntchito zamabizinesi zikamalumikizana mosadukiza, deta imasiya kukhala yongopereka malipoti ndipo imakhala dalaivala wamkulu wa luso la magwiridwe antchito.
businessTransformation.sec5Subtext: Kuwona mwatsatanetsatane madera akuluakulu aukadaulo omwe amapanga maziko amakono, owopsa.
businessTransformation.sec6Subtext: Kupititsa patsogolo kamangidwe ka ntchito ndi kulumikiza deta yogawika kumapereka kusintha kowoneka bwino m'bungwe lonse.
businessTransformation.ctaDescription: Onani momwe zomangamanga zamakono zogwiritsira ntchito, deta yolumikizidwa ndi teknoloji yowonjezereka ingathandizire mabungwe kukonza bwino ndikukonzekera kukula kwamtsogolo.
businessTransformation.sec1P1: M'malo abizinesi, kukula nthawi zambiri kumayambitsa mibadwo ingapo yamapulogalamu. Zachuma, chain chain, ntchito zamakasitomala, ndi ntchito zakumunda nthawi zambiri zimagwira ntchito pamapulogalamu osiyanasiyana omwe amapezedwa kapena kumangidwa nthawi zosiyanasiyana. Kwa zaka zambiri zakusintha kwa magwiridwe antchito, makinawa amapanga mawonekedwe awoawo a data, ma cadences osinthika, ndi zina zophatikizira.

businessTransformation.sec1P3: Kuthana ndi zovutazi kumafuna kuwona momwe ukadaulo waukadaulo osati kusonkhanitsa kwapaokha kugula mapulogalamu, koma ngati nsanja yolumikizidwa yabizinesi yomwe idapangidwa kuti izithandizira luso laukadaulo.

sec2Cards.desc: Makasitomala ofunikira, azachuma, ndi zinthu zomwe zidasungidwa amakhalabe m'mapulatifomu am'madipatimenti, kuletsa malingaliro amodzi ogwirizana abizinesi.

sec2Cards.desc: Malumikizidwe olunjika ndi ma batch ausiku amapanga latency, kulephera kwakukulu, komanso kukonza zokwera mtengo m'magulu onse ogwira ntchito.

sec2Cards.title: Chidziwitso Chachedwa
sec2Cards.desc: Pamene akuluakulu akuyenera kudikirira masiku kuti agwirizanenso kumapeto kwa mwezi kuti amvetsetse momwe ntchito ikugwirira ntchito, kupanga zisankho kumakhala kokhazikika m'malo molosera.

businessTransformation.sec3P1: Zomangamanga zamakono zamakono zimalowa m'malo mwa brittle point-to-point kugwirizana ndi maziko agile, osakanikirana. Pokhazikitsa API yolimba ndi kusanjikiza kophatikizana, machitidwe amalumikizana kudzera m'malo olamulidwa, otetezeka pomwe akusunga kudziyimira pawokha kwa magawo abizinesi.
businessTransformation.sec3P2: Zofunikira zaukadaulo pakusintha komanga uku zikuphatikiza:

sec3List.text: Kuphatikizira malingaliro abizinesi kukhala ma scalable modular services.
Kukhazikitsa zolumikizana zokhazikika, zolembedwa kuti zizigwirizana mkati ndi abwenzi.

sec3List.bold: Kuphatikiza kwa data & kukhathamiritsa kwa database:
sec3List.text: Kugwirizanitsa mapaipi a data ogwira ntchito ndi kukhathamiritsa kwamafunso apamwamba.
Kukhazikitsa ma telemetry apakati, njira zowerengera, ndi njira zolumikizirana ndi anthu pazantchito zonse.

businessTransformation.sec4P1: Maziko ophatikizika a data amasintha momwe utsogoleri ndi magulu ogwirira ntchito amalumikizirana ndi chidziwitso. M'malo modalira malipoti obwereza omwe akuwonetsa zomwe zidachitika masabata apitawa, mabungwe amapeza ma telemetry omwe amagwira ntchito pamabizinesi onse.
businessTransformation.sec4P2: Deta yolumikizidwa ndi ma analytics amathandizira zotulukapo zokhazikika zamabizinesi kudzera:

sec4List.text: Kuwonekera mosalekeza pazogulitsa, zosungira, kukwaniritsa, ndi momwe ndalama zikuyendera.
Kusonkhanitsa deta pakufunika komwe kumachotsa maspredishiti amanja obwerezabwereza.
Matanthauzo amodzi a ma metrics ngati malire, mtengo wanthawi zonse wamakasitomala, komanso kuthamanga kwanthawi yayitali.
Kuzindikira kwamtsogolo komwe kumawonetsa zoopsa ndi mwayi pasadakhale.
Zochita zodalirika zotsogola zothandizidwa ndi mzere wovomerezeka wa data komanso kuwonekera.

artificialIntelligence.sec1Subtext: Artificial intelligence ikusintha kuchoka pamapulojekiti ammbali kupita kuzinthu zazikulu zomwe mabizinesi amadalira tsiku lililonse.
artificialIntelligence.sec2Subtext: Kupitilira zolembedwa zozikidwa pachikhalidwe kupita kumayendedwe azidziwitso omwe amamvetsetsa zomwe sizinapangike, kusintha kusiyanasiyana, ndikusintha njira mwachangu.
artificialIntelligence.sec3Subtext: Mozikidwa pa chidziwitso cha bungwe ndi chitetezo chamabizinesi, othandizira a AI amakhala ngati othandizana nawo apadera pamayendedwe abizinesi atsiku ndi tsiku.
artificialIntelligence.sec4Subtext: Kusintha zipika zamabizinesi akale komanso ma feed a nthawi yeniyeni kuti azitha kuwoneratu zam'tsogolo.
artificialIntelligence.sec5Subtext: Njira zenizeni zotsogola mabungwe akugwiritsira ntchito luntha lochita kupanga pazantchito zazikulu zamabizinesi.
artificialIntelligence.sec6Subtext: Ikakhazikitsidwa moganizira ndi data yamabizinesi, AI imatsegula zabwino zambiri.
artificialIntelligence.ctaHeading: Onani Mwayi wa AI pa Bizinesi Yanu
artificialIntelligence.ctaDescription: Dziwani momwe makina anzeru, oyendetsa mabizinesi ndi zitsanzo zolosera zingatsegulire magwiridwe antchito pamakina anu onse.
artificialIntelligence.sec1P1: Kwa zaka zambiri, luntha lochita kupanga lamakampani linkawonedwa ngati luso lakunja: chitsanzo chophunzitsidwa kudzipatula, chiwonetsero cha sandbox, kapena chatbot yapayokha yopezeka kudzera pa portal ina. Masiku ano, paradigm yasintha kwambiri. AI yamabizinesi apamwamba kwambiri imayikidwa mwachindunji mkati mwa machitidwe ojambulira - ma ERP, ma CRM, nsanja za anthu, ndi ma injini ogulitsa komwe bizinesi yeniyeni imachitika.
artificialIntelligence.sec1P2: Pamene nzeru zimagwira ntchito mkati mwa kalembedwe, zimatengera malire a chitetezo cha bungwe, zitsanzo za deta, ndi malingaliro abizinesi. Sichimangopanga mayankho achibadwa; imagwira ntchito motsatira madongosolo amoyo, imatanthauzira matikiti otseguka, imayanjanitsa ma invoice ogulitsa, ndikuthandizira ogwira ntchito m'malo omwe amayendera tsiku lililonse.
artificialIntelligence.sec1P3: Kusinthaku kumasuntha mapulogalamu abizinesi kuchokera pazosungidwa zomwe zimadikirira makiyi a anthu kukhala nsanja zomwe zimayembekezera zosowa, masitepe odzipangira okha, ndi malingaliro apanthawi yake.
artificialIntelligence.sec2P1: Traditional Robotic Process Automation (RPA) idachita bwino kwambiri pakujambula, kubwereza bwereza. Komabe, malamulo okhwima amatha kusweka nthawi iliyonse mawonekedwe akusintha, mawonekedwe osayembekezeka a chikalata akafika, kapena zosiyana zimachitika. Intelligent automation imagwirizanitsa magawano awa pophatikiza kulingalira kwachidziwitso ndi kuchitapo kanthu:

sec2List.text: Kukonza ntchito zovuta m'madipatimenti osiyanasiyana, kuwongolera ntchito potengera kufulumira komanso njira zosinthira mbiri yakale.
Kulowetsa ma PDF osakhazikika, maimelo, ziwonetsero zotumizira, ndi makontrakitala, kuwasintha kukhala ma database opangidwa mwadongosolo.
Kudzipangira zokha zotsimikizira za ntchito zambiri—monga kufananiza maoda ogula ndi malisiti ndi masitatimendi akubanki.
Kusanthula mosalekeza zipika kuti muzindikire zopinga za nthawi yozungulira ndikupangira kuwongolera komwe kumayendera.

copilotCards.desc: Kumasulira mafunso okambitsirana kukhala mafunso ovuta kusanthula, kupanga chidule cha ma chart pa ntchentche ndikuwunikira zofunikira za utsogoleri.

copilotCards.desc: Kuwonetsetsa kuti mayankho a oyendetsa ndege akulemekeza kwambiri zilolezo za ogwiritsa ntchito, kusunga chinsinsi chandalama, mafayilo a HR, ndi luntha lotetezedwa.

artificialIntelligence.sec4P1: Ngakhale njira zopangira zimapambana pakumvetsetsa ndi kuphatikizira zilankhulo, luntha lolosera limayang'ana masamu obisika mkati mwazosunga zosungidwa zamabizinesi. sec4List.text: Kulosera momwe ndalama zidzakhalire, kuthamanga kwa zinthu, ndi zofuna zazinthu popanga zizindikiro za nyengo ndi kuthamanga kwa mapaipi a nthawi yeniyeni.

Kuyimilira zolakwika pazachuma, zolemba zamalamulo, ndi njira zogulira mavenda zisanachuluke.

modernErp.sec1Subtext: ERP sikulinso ma accounting akuofesi. Ndilo njira yoyendetsera bizinesi yamakono yowonetsedwa mu mapulogalamu.
modernErp.sec2Subtext: Mtengo weniweni wabungwe umawonekera pomwe ntchito zazikulu zamabizinesi zimayendera limodzi pamaziko a digito.
modernErp.sec3Subtext: Kugwetsa mipanda yolumikizirana pakati pa madipatimenti kuti athandizire kuyenda kwamadzimadzi, kolumikizana ndi mabizinesi.
modernErp.sec4Subtext: Kuphatikiza ma metric ogwirira ntchito kukhala ma dashboard owonekera omwe amawonetsa zenizeni zamabizinesi.
modernErp.sec5Subtext: Zomangamanga zomwe zimalekanitsa nsanja za ERP zamasiku ano ndi zokhazikika zokhazikika.

modernErp.ctaDescription: Onani momwe nsanja zamakono za ERP zimalumikizirana ndi zachuma, zogula, zogulitsira ndi ntchito zamabizinesi kudzera pamaziko olumikizana a digito.
modernErp.sec1P1: M'mabizinesi omwe akuyenda mwachangu, machitidwe achikhalidwe a Enterprise Resource Planning nthawi zambiri amakhala ovuta. Zomangidwa munthawi yokonza ma batch ndi ma seva akutali, ma ERP adasinthidwa mwamakonda, ovuta kukweza, komanso opaque mopweteka. Mabizinesi ofunikira amagwirira ntchito m'malo ofananirako, kudalira zotumiza kunja usiku umodzi kuti alumikizitse ma leja ndi malo osungira.
modernErp.sec1P2: ERP yamakono, yamtundu wamtambo imatanthauziranso izi. Imagwira ntchito ngati msana wa digito wabizinesi - maziko amoyo pomwe ndalama, zogula, zogulitsira, zowerengera, ndi zinthu za anthu zimayenderana ndi data yogawana.
modernErp.sec1P3: Mwa kubweretsa ntchito zazikuluzikulu mu malo amodzi ogwirizana, ERP yamakono imachotsa malo osawona ogwira ntchito omwe amachepetsa kukula, zomwe zimathandiza atsogoleri kuyendetsa bizinesi pogwiritsa ntchito zizindikiro zenizeni m'malo mofotokoza mwachidule mbiri yakale.
modernErp.sec3P1: Silo zogwirira ntchito nthawi zambiri zimakhala zovuta za anthu; iwo ndi zovuta zomanga. Pamene magulu othandizira makasitomala, ogula zinthu, ndi osungira katundu amagwira ntchito m'mapulogalamu osalumikizidwa, ntchito iliyonse imafuna maimelo apamanja, ma spreadsheets, ndi mafoni. Zolakwa zikuchulukirachulukira, ma invoice amasungidwa, ndipo kulonjeza kwamakasitomala kumachepa.
modernErp.sec3P2: ERP yamakono imayankha izi kudzera mumzere wolumikizana wa data ndi kuyimba koyendetsedwa ndi zochitika:

sec3List.text: Oda yamakasitomala ikayikidwa, zosungira zimasungidwa zokha, zolemba zotumizira zimapanga, ndipo zolemba zolipira zimasinthidwa nthawi yomweyo.
Maoda ogulira, malisiti a katundu, ndi ma invoice a ogulitsa zimangofanana ndi kuyanjanitsa kwa njira zitatu, zomwe zimangosonyeza kuti anthu sangaunikenso.
Zolemba zanthawi ya polojekiti, kugawika kwa malipiro, ndi ndalama zoyendetsera ntchito zolunjika ku malo opangira ndalama munthawi yeniyeni.

modernErp.sec4P1: Kuyendetsa bizinesi popanda mawonekedwe ogwirizana kuli ngati kuwuluka muufunga ndi zida zochedwa. ERP yamakono imapereka telemetry yeniyeni pa bizinesi iliyonse:

sec4List.text: Kuwona nthawi yomweyo kwa ndalama zonse, kuyendetsa ndalama, mangawa otseguka, ndi kuyitanitsa zotsalira popanda kuyembekezera kutseka kwa nthawi.
Akuluakulu a m’madipatimenti atha kupanga mafunso okhazikika ndikuyang’ana pansi kuchokera pa chidule cha mabizinesi kupita ku zinthu zamtundu uliwonse.
Kuchotsa manambala otsutsana pokhazikitsa deta imodzi yoyendetsedwa ndi makasitomala, ogulitsa, ndi makatalogu azinthu.
Zidziwitso zodziwikiratu zimadziwitsa oyang'anira nthawi yomweyo mizere ikatsika, kuchuluka kwa zinthu kutsika, kapena kutsika kwa ma supplier delivery.

incidentReadinessPhases.title: Kusunga & Kudzipatula
incidentReadinessPhases.desc: Malamulo okhazikika okhala ndi ma netiweki odzipatula opatula zotengera zomwe zasokonekera kapena zidziwitso nthawi yomweyo.

incidentReadinessPhases.title: Kukonzanso & Choyambitsa
incidentReadinessPhases.desc: Kutulutsa kofulumira kwa zigamba ndi maumboni a digito omwe amazindikiritsa vector yophwanya.

incidentReadinessPhases.title: Kupirira & Kuwumitsa
incidentReadinessPhases.desc: Ndemanga mosalekeza muzosunga zosunga zobwezeretsera zosasinthika, zolondera zamalamulo, ndi zoyeserera zamagulu ofiira.

cyberBusinessBenefits: Kuchepetsa kwakukulu pakuwukira pachiwopsezo pamitengo yamtambo
Kutsimikizika kopitilira ntchito ndikubwezeretsa masoka ndi RTO/RPO yochepa
Chikhulupiriro chonse chotsatira ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, ndi GDPR
Kutetezedwa kwa chidziwitso chazachuma komanso mbiri yachinsinsi yamakasitomala
Ulamuliro wowongolera wamabizinesi ndi chipani chachitatu kudzera muulamuliro wolumikizana
Kudalirika kwa kasitomala ndi Investor mothandizidwa ndi zotsimikizika zachitetezo cha zero-trust
zeroTrustPrinciples: Osakhulupirira, Tsimikizani Nthawi Zonse: Kutsimikizika kwatsatanetsatane kumafunika pakuchita kulikonse
Kufikira Mwamwayi Wochepa: Malire ang'onoang'ono omwe amalepheretsa kusuntha koopsa
Tangoganizani Kuphwanya: Kuwunika kosalekeza kuwopseza, kubisalira poyenda komanso popuma
Micro-Segmentation: Zozimitsa moto pamaneti zomwe zimalekanitsa ntchito zamtundu uliwonse
Telemetry Yopitilira: Kusanthula kwamakhalidwe kodziwikiratu komwe kumawonetsa zopempha zapagawo zosasangalatsa
cybersecurity.sec1Subtext: Pamene mabungwe amakono akugwirizanitsa ntchito zambiri, malo osungira mitambo, ogwira ntchito akutali, mafoni a m'manja, ndi mabwenzi a chipani chachitatu, chigawo cha chitetezo chachikhalidwe chimasiya kukhalapo.
cybersecurity.sec2Subtext: Chitetezo chokhazikika chomwe chimateteza zida zofunika kwambiri, chidziwitso chamakampani, ndi machitidwe ogwirira ntchito.
cybersecurity.sec3Subtext: Identity ndiye maziko oyendetsera chitetezo chamakono. Pafupifupi kuphwanya kwakukulu kwachitetezo kumayamba ndi zidziwitso zosokoneza m'malo mogwiritsa ntchito mapulogalamu.
cybersecurity.sec4Subtext: Zero Trust si chinthu chimodzi kapena chida. Ndi njira yomanga yozikidwa pa mfundo yowongoka: musakhulupirire gulu mkati kapena kunja kwa netiweki mwachisawawa.
cybersecurity.sec5Subtext: Kuteteza zochulukira pamtambo wapagulu, zomangamanga zosakanizidwa, ndi malo ogawa.
cybersecurity.sec6Subtext: Kulimba mtima kwenikweni kwa pa intaneti kumavomereza kuti zochitika zitha kuchitika. Kukonzekera kumayang'ana pakusunga mwachangu, kusokoneza pang'ono kwa bizinesi, ndikutsimikizira kuchira.
cybersecurity.sec7Subtext: Kumanga bizinesi yolimbana ndi intaneti kumateteza kufunikira kwa bungwe, kaimidwe ka kayendetsedwe kake, komanso mbiri ya msika.
cybersecurity.ctaDescription: Onani momwe mabungwe angalimbikitsire chitetezo, kuteteza machitidwe ovuta ndikukonzekera ziwopsezo m'malo olumikizana kwambiri.
cybersecurity.sec1P1: Munthawi yabizinesi ya IT, chitetezo chinkagwiritsidwa ntchito pa chiphunzitso cha castle-and-moat: chilichonse chomwe chili mkati mwa ofesi yamakampani chimaonedwa kuti ndi chodalirika, pomwe chilichonse chakunja chimawonedwa ngati chosadalirika. Chowotcha moto chamakampani chimateteza ma seva amkati, ma database, ndi makompyuta apakompyuta.
cybersecurity.sec1P2: Mabizinesi amasiku ano ali ndi makoma akuthupi. Ntchito zambiri zimakhala m'malo okhala ndi mitambo yambiri (AWS, Azure, GCP), ogwira ntchito amapeza mabizinesi kuchokera kumadera osiyanasiyana, ndipo ma API amasinthasintha mosalekeza zomwe zimagwira ntchito ndi opereka zida zakunja, mabungwe azachuma, ndi ogulitsa SaaS.
cybersecurity.sec1P3: Ngakhale kulumikizana kwa hyperku kumapangitsa kuti bizinesi ikhale yolimba, imakulitsa kwambiri kuukira kwa mabizinesi. Mapeto aliwonse a API, chizindikiro cha chizindikiritso, foni yam'manja yolumikizidwa, ndi kuphatikiza kwa SaaS kumayimira vector yowonekera. Kutetezedwa kowona kwa mabizinesi kumafuna kusintha kuchoka pachitetezo chokhazikika kupita kuchitetezo chokhazikika, chakumapeto mpaka kumapeto kwa cyber.

sec2Cards.title: Kuzindikira Zowopsa
sec2Cards.desc: Kuphunzira pogwiritsa ntchito makina kumawopseza nzeru zomwe zimayang'anira machitidwe odabwitsa a netiweki, nkhanza zodziwika bwino, komanso kusatetezeka kwamasiku angapo munthawi yeniyeni.

sec2Cards.title: Kuwunika Chitetezo
sec2Cards.desc: Centralized Security Operations Center (SOC) telemetry yolumikizana zochitika pamaseva, magulu a zotengera, opereka zidziwitso, ndi ma endpoints.

sec2Cards.title: Vulnerability Management
sec2Cards.desc: Kusanthula mosalekeza za chiwopsezo pazipangizo zonse, nkhokwe zosungira, ndi zolembera zotengera kuti muthetse zofooka mwachangu.

sec2Cards.title: Chitetezo cha Data
sec2Cards.desc: Robust encryption in transit (TLS 1.3) ndi popuma (AES-256), pamodzi ndi granular data loss prevention (DLP) ulamuliro kuteteza kutayikira kwaluntha.

cybersecurity.sec3P1: Kuteteza katundu wabizinesi kumafuna kuwonetsetsa kuti chizindikiritso chilichonse—kaya ndi munthu wamkulu, kontrakitala wakunja, kapena akaunti yodziyimira payokha yamapulogalamu apulogalamu—chatsimikizira chilolezo chazinthu zenizeni zomwe amapeza.

sec3List.text: Single Sign-On (SSO) ndi mfundo zodziwika bwino zomwe zimachotsa masitolo achinsinsi ogawanika pamapulogalamu onse.
Makiyi a hardware a FIDO2 osagwiritsa ntchito Phishing ndi zovuta zokhudzana ndi chiopsezo pazantchito zowunikira.
Fine-grained Role-Based (RBAC) ndi Attribute-Based (ABAC) maulamuliro ofikira omwe amatsatiridwa pa API ndi ma database.
Kupereka mwayi wofikira kwakanthawi, munthawi yake (JIT) womwe umatha ntchito zikangotha ntchito zoyang'anira.

cybersecurity.keyPerspectiveTitle: Kutsimikizika Kopitilira Pamaso pa Blind Trust
cybersecurity.keyPerspectiveLead: Mu kamangidwe ka Zero Trust, kudalira kotheratu kutengera malo a netiweki kumathetsedwa. Kuchitika kulikonse, funso la database, ndi kulowa kwa ogwiritsa ntchito ziyenera kutsimikizira kulondola kwake:

cloudSecurityCards.title: Udindo Wogawana
cloudSecurityCards.desc: Ulamuliro womveka bwino womwe umasiyanitsa chitetezo chakuthupi cha opereka mtambo ndiudindo wabizinesi pakubisa deta, mfundo za IAM, ndi ma code ogwiritsira ntchito.

cloudSecurityCards.title: Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
cloudSecurityCards.desc: Zosasinthika, zosinthika zamtambo zomwe zimayendetsedwa ndi code. Makina ojambulira a policy-as-code amaletsa kusasinthika ndi zidebe zowonekera asanatumizidwe.

cloudSecurityCards.title: Container & Kubernetes Security
cloudSecurityCards.desc: Nthawi zoyendetsera ziwiya zolimba, zolembetsa zazithunzi zosayinidwa, magawo ang'onoang'ono a netiweki, ndi kasamalidwe kachinsinsi komwe kamapangitsa kuti mbiri isatuluke.

cloudModernization.subtitle: Onani njira zothandiza zowunika, kusinthiratu ndikusuntha zomwe zidachitika kale kuti zigwirizane ndi mamangidwe otetezeka a mitambo.

modernizationApproaches.title: Rehost (Kwezani & Shift)
modernizationApproaches.desc: Kusintha kwa ntchito zosinthira makina owoneka bwino mwachangu ndikusinthidwa pang'ono.

modernizationApproaches.title: Replatform (Nyamulani & Reshape)
modernizationApproaches.desc: Sinthani zoyendetsera nthawi yoyendetsera ntchito, gwiritsani ntchito nkhokwe zosungidwa zamtambo, ndikuwongolera magwiridwe antchito.

modernizationApproaches.title: Refactor (Cloud-Native Rebuild)
modernizationApproaches.desc: Pangani ma monoliths kukhala ma microservices okhala ndi ma API opanda seva.

modernizationApproaches.title: Bwezerani (SaaS Modernization)
modernizationApproaches.desc: Retire regacy systems mokomera mapulogalamu opangira mabizinesi amtambo.

cloudArchitectureFlow.title: Kuwunika kwa Cholowa
cloudArchitectureFlow.desc: Mapu odalira pawokha, kulemba ngongole zaukadaulo, ndi zigoli zokonzekera mitambo.

cloudArchitectureFlow.title: Zomangamanga Zolinga
cloudArchitectureFlow.desc: Mapulani a Microservice Modular, topology ya ziwiya, ndi ma tempuleti a IaC.

cloudArchitectureFlow.title: Kusamuka Kwapang'onopang'ono
cloudArchitectureFlow.desc: Kutulutsa kwa Canary, kulunzanitsa kwa data yolemba-pawiri, ndi mafunde odulira zero-downtime cutover.

cloudArchitectureFlow.title: Kukhathamiritsa Kwamtambo
cloudArchitectureFlow.desc: Ulamuliro wamtengo wapatali, autoscaling telemetry, ndi ndemanga za FinOps.

cloudModernizationBenefits: Zotsika mtengo kwambiri zokonzetsera zomangamanga ndi zotsitsimutsa za hardware
Pafupi-infinite compute elasticity yosamalira kuchuluka kwa mabizinesi omwe ali ndi zero latency
Kuthamanga kwachangu kotulutsa ndi mapaipi odzipangira okha a CI/CD
Kuchotsa mfundo zolephera za cholowa chimodzi ndi kupezeka kwakukulu kwa AZ
Zomangamanga zamakono za API zomwe zimathandizira kuphatikizika kwa ma pulatifomu mwachangu
Kuwoneka kwapamwamba pa nthawi yeniyeni pakugwiritsa ntchito ntchito komanso kugwiritsa ntchito mtambo
landscapeAssessmentPoints: Kupanga mapu kudalira kwapakati-mapulogalamu ndi ma cadence olumikizana ndi data
Kuzindikiritsa masanjidwe achilengedwe okhazikika komanso madongosolo a database
Kuyang'anira kutsata malamulo ndi zopinga zaulamuliro wa data paulamuliro uliwonse
Kuwerengera zenizeni Mtengo Wonse wa Mwini (TCO) kudutsa njira zofananira ndi rehost
Kukhazikitsa mafunde omveka bwino kuti ateteze mabizinesi ogwira ntchito tsiku ndi tsiku
cloudModernization.sec1Subtext: Ma monoliths okalamba amachepetsa kuthamanga kwazinthu zatsopano, amawonjezera zovuta zogwirira ntchito, ndikukweza mtengo wokonza zomangamanga.
cloudModernization.sec2Subtext: Kuchita bwino kwamakono kwamtambo kumayamba ndikuwunika mozama. Kudumphira molunjika kukusamuka popanda kuyang'anira kudalira kwa mapulogalamu ndiye chifukwa chachikulu cha kuchedwetsedwa kwa ma cutovers.
cloudModernization.sec3Subtext: Palibe njira imodzi yofanana ndi kusamuka. Mabizinesi otsogola amafananiza njira yoyenera yosinthira pantchito iliyonse kutengera mtengo wabizinesi, changu, ndi ngongole zaukadaulo.
cloudModernization.sec4Subtext: Msewu wokonzedwa bwino womwe umasintha ma monoliths kukhala zotanuka, zotetezeka, komanso zosungika zamtambo.
cloudModernization.sec5Subtext: Kusuntha machitidwe olowa m'malo opangira mitambo yamakono kumapereka mphamvu yowoneka bwino yogwirira ntchito komanso kulosera mtengo.
cloudModernization.ctaHeading: Sinthani Mapulogalamu Anu a Cholowa Chanu
cloudModernization.ctaDescription: Onani njira yothandiza yowunika, kusinthiratu ndikusuntha zomwe zidachitika kale kuti zigwirizane ndi mamangidwe otetezeka a mitambo.
cloudModernization.sec1P1: Mapulogalamu ofunikira kwambiri omwe adamangidwa zaka khumi zapitazo amayendetsabe mabiliyoni ambiri pamabizinesi, komabe kusakhazikika kwawo pamapangidwe kumabweretsa chiwopsezo chokulirapo.
cloudModernization.sec1P2: Bizinesi iliyonse imayang'anizana ndi kusamvana pakati pa kukhazikika ndi kusinthika. Machitidwe obadwa nawo adapangidwa kuti azikhala olimba, ndipo akhala akugwira ntchito modalirika kwa zaka zambiri. Komabe, momwe zofunikira zamabizinesi zikuchulukira, zomanga zokalambazi zimakumana ndi malire:

sec1List.text: Ma codebases a monolithic omangidwa pazifukwa zomwe zidasiyidwa zokhala ndi dziwe la talente lochepera lomwe likupezeka kuti likonze.
Zigawo zolumikizidwa mwamphamvu pomwe kusintha gawo limodzi kumatha kuswa ma module osagwirizana.
Malire okwera omwe amafunikira kugula zida zodula kuti athe kuthana ndi kuchuluka kwa magalimoto pakanthawi.
Kulephera kulumikizana bwino ndi mapulogalamu am'manja amakono, ma portal amakasitomala, kapena ma API othandizana nawo opanda ma batch script osalimba.
Zozungulira zapachipinda cha seva, zofooka zosunga zobwezeretsera, komanso kugwiritsa ntchito mphamvu zambiri / kuzirala.

cloudModernization.sec2P1: Ulendo wamakono wamakono umayamba ndikukhazikitsa zomveka bwino pa malo omwe alipo:

sec2List.text: Kuwerengera zonse zomwe zikugwira ntchito, ma module achikhalidwe, zolemba zakumbuyo, ndi phukusi lambiri la chipani chachitatu.
Kupanga mapu ovuta kulumikiza nthawi yothamanga, matebulo a database omwe amagawana, kuyimba kwa mafayilo achindunji, ndi makontrakitala akunja.
Kuunikira kapangidwe ka data, zofunikira pazantchito, kusungitsa zosunga zobwezeretsera, ndi malamulo owongolera.
Auditing CPU, kukumbukira, kagwiritsidwe ntchito kakusungirako, ndi ma network kudzera pamiyeso yamtambo yomwe mukufuna.
Kugawa mapulogalamu m'magulu kuti apange mafunde otetezeka, osasunthika omwe ali ndi njira zobwerera m'mbuyo.

cloudModernization.sec4P1: Zomangamanga zomwe mukupita zimagawaniza ntchito zazikuluzikulu kukhala ma modular, ntchito zokhala ndi zotengera zomwe zimachitika pamapulatifomu amtambo (monga Kubernetes kapena nthawi zoyendetsedwa zopanda seva).
cloudModernization.sec4P2: Pokhazikitsa mapaipi otumizira a CI/CD odzipangira okha, zodula zobiriwira zabuluu, ndi zomangamanga monga ma code, kutumizidwa kumasintha kuchokera ku zochitika zakumapeto za sabata kukhala zochitika zatsiku ndi tsiku zopanda msoko.
cloudModernization.sec4P3: Compute yokhuthala imangodzikweza yokha pakufunika kwa kukwera ndi kutsika panthawi yaphokoso, ndikuchotsa mtengo wazinthu zopanda ntchito ndikutsimikizira kuyankha kwa mphindi yachiwiri kwa ogwiritsa ntchito padziko lonse lapansi.
cloudModernization.keyPerspectiveLead: Zochitika zikuwonetsa kuti ntchito zamakono zimayenda bwino zikakhazikitsidwa pakukonzekera kwathunthu, kutsata mafunde momveka bwino, komanso kuyesa mwamphamvu:
